# Muhammad Ishaq

> Muhammad Ishaq is a Full Stack Developer based in Islamabad, Pakistan, who builds AI-powered web products (streaming AI chat and voice assistants, SaaS dashboards, and booking and payment platforms) with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js. Muhammad holds a BS in Software Engineering (CGPA 3.72/4.00) and works remotely with INSTLY Technologies (Thailand) and onsite with CODEHAVEN Solutions (Islamabad).

## Pages
- [Home](/): About, experience, education, skills, selected projects and contact.

## Selected work
- Expat Medicare (https://expatmedicare.com/): multilingual health insurance comparison platform with an AI adviser.
- Cira (https://askainurse.com/): AI healthcare assistant with chat, voice and camera-based vital-sign scanning.
- Stellar OS (https://stellaros.ai/): insurance operations and broker management platform.
- Courses4Me (https://courses4me.co.uk/): UK security training course booking platform.
- Karyana Shop (https://karyana.shop/): multi-branch POS and inventory SaaS for grocery stores.
